_comment: Edit this file to customize the runner. Secrets (tokens, keys) live in ~/.nexus/secrets.env, NOT here.
_backend_comment: Which backend handles user messages: 'claude-code' (shells out to the `claude` CLI — uses your subscription, much cheaper) or 'nexus' (NexusEngine direct, uses ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = pay-per-token).

schedule._comment: 5-field cron in your local timezone (set TZ in start.sh). Set briefingCron to null to disable.

allowlist._comment: users: Telegram user IDs always allowed (in DMs and in approved groups). groups: chat IDs of approved groups (negative numbers). pendingGroups: auto-populated when an unknown group messages the bot — review and move to groups[] to approve.

telegram._comment: pollIntervalMs: how often to poll for updates. Lower = more responsive, higher = fewer API calls.

whisper._comment: Local Whisper transcription for voice messages. command: path to whisper CLI (e.g. 'whisper' or '/usr/local/bin/whisper'). model: tiny/base/small/medium/large.
